The new hooks-only UNION branch (reader.py:3742-3757) guards against a duplicate OTel-sourced row but omits the `dispatch_fork` guard the skill-fallback branch directly above it already has, so a slash-command's foreground (no-skill-name) fork can be double-counted as both a dispatch_fork row and a plain-agent row (CR-001, major, request-changes). findings.title: Hooks-only agent branch misses dispatch_fork guard
findings.problem: The new plain-agent hooks-only UNION branch (reader.py:3742-3757) selects any agent.subagent.start hook with agent_type set and skill_name empty, but unlike the skill-fallback branch directly above it (which has `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_fork df WHERE df.agent_id = h.agent_id)` at line 3731), this branch has no guard against `dispatch_fork`. The dispatch_fork CTE's LATERAL match (reader.py:3487-3499) accepts a fork candidate with an empty skill_name as a slash-command's foreground fork, so the same agent_id can be claimed by both.
findings.impact: A slash-command dispatch whose foreground fork reports no skill_name on its own SubagentStart hook gets a row from the dispatch_fork-based UNION branch (reader.py:3758-3780) and a second, duplicate row from this new branch for the same agent_id, double-counting the agent's Timeline bar, duration and cost.
findings.recommendation: Add `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_fork df WHERE df.agent_id = h.agent_id)` to this branch's WHERE clause, mirroring the identical guard already present in the skill-fallback branch above (reader.py:3731).

fix.change: Added `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_fork df WHERE df.agent_id = h.agent_id)` to the hooks-only plain-agent UNION branch in get_session_detail_dispatches (reader.py), mirroring the skill-fallback branch's existing guard.

deferred.title: Agent fork with no type and no skill name stays invisible
deferred.problem: An agent.subagent.start hook event whose agent_type and skill_name are both empty matches no UNION branch (new branch requires agent_type <> '', skill-fallback requires skill_name <> ''), so it never surfaces in the Timeline.
deferred.preexisting: The AGENTS tile already assumes agent_type <> '' for a subagent fork (reader.py:3203); this is a system-wide, pre-existing data assumption this change does not alter.
